what: WORKED COMPUTATION (independent run 1 of 2): Is light-cone formation reversible? The record at (t+1, x) is drawn with probability prop. to exp(beta s.S_x), S_x the sum of the level-t records at x and its neighbours (the site ITSELF included). Claim to test: the synchronous chain is reversible with respect to pi(s) prop. to prod_x Z(S_x(s)), Z(S) = sum over the menu of exp(beta s.S), because sum_x s'_x.S_x(s) = sum_x s_x.S_x(s') for a symmetric neighbourhood. (1) Prove the symmetry identity and the detailed-balance equation on paper (three lines). (2) Verify exactly on the periodic 4-cycle and the 2x2 torus for the six-axis menu with exp(beta s.s') weights at beta = 1/2, 1 (rational arithmetic with e^beta replaced by a rational t: weights t, 1/t, 1): full transition matrix, stationary law, detailed balance. (3) Show the BACKWARD neighbourhood {x, x - e_j} fails detailed balance with any product-form pi on the same windows. (4) For the general six-axis weights (p,q,r), which are not of the form exp(beta s.s') unless q = 1/p... state what replaces s.S and whether reversibility survives. Expectation: (1)-(3) hold. DELIVERABLE in your unit worktree: probes/work/compute/lightcone-reversibility-exact/<your worker name>/run.py (self-contained; exact arithmetic wherever the statement is exact; numpy only for the numerical cross-checks named) and RESULT.md (the table or formulas, in plain text). run.py prints one line per result, a final `SUMMARY: <the main result in one line>`, and `HIT: <what>` ONLY if a result contradicts the expectation stated in the task (that is the interesting case: report it precisely). Two workers do each computation independently; the supervisor compares them. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/compute/lightcone-reversibility-exact/<name>/run.py"
